build_pass_manager: build a PassManager with a list of passes and constraints to validate and execute a pass schedule
create_loop_pass: create a loop_pass wrapper to apply a base pass multiple times using n_iter or a predicate
create_inplace_wrapper: create an inplace_wrapper so a pass that modifies an object in-place returns the modified object
create_log_hook: create a log_hook wrapper to log the output of a pass at a specified logging level
test_pass_constraint: test a these_before_those_pass_constraint to enforce ordering between wrapped passes in a PassManager
